title: Performance of Private Corporate Business Sector during 2025-26
description: Today, the Reserve Bank released data on the performance of the private corporate sector during 2025-26 drawn from abridged financial results of 4,278 listed non-government non-financial (NGNF) companies. Corresponding data pertaining to 2024-25 are also presented in the tables to enable comparison. The data can be accessed at the web-link – https://data.rbi.org.in/DBIE/#/dbie/reports/Statistics/Corporate%20Sector/Listed%20Non-Government%20Non-Financial%20Companies. Highlights Sales During
